nodes.text: I commend you today, N., to almighty God,
with the same faithfulness with which he commended his mother to Saint John,
and to the same grace with which he commended his spirit
to his Father, when on the holy cross he was
to die; and in the same grace and with the same
faithfulness as when he chose Saint Mary for himself as
a mother, and [she] him as a son; and in the grace
in which good Jacob commended his son to him, when he sent him to
the land of Egypt; and in the same grace in which
good Tobias commended his son, when he sent him into the
land, to the kingdom of the Medes. I commend you, N., to almighty
God and into his holy hand. I commend you today,
N., to the holy five wounds of our Lord. I commend
you, N., to faithful Saint Peter, and in the same
grace in which holy Christ entrusted to him his sheep and the
keys of heaven. I commend you, N., to Saint John,
and in the grace in which he entrusted his mother to him. I commend
you today, N., to the holy words of our Lord, so that
today no enemy may harm you, visible or
invisible; with the holy Father and with the
Son and with the Holy Spirit; with the holy power with which
he went from heaven to earth and from
earth to heaven. May they be bound today, so that they have no eyes
with which they might see what [may] harm you; that
they have no mouth, so that they may not speak what may
harm you; that they may have no ears, so that
they may not hear what may harm you; that they
may have no heart, so that they think nothing that
might harm you; that their hands be hewn off,
so that they touch nothing that may harm you; that they
have no feet to walk or even to stand that may
harm you. To the most holy right hand of our Lord, the
almighty God, to it I commend today your body and your
soul and your worldly honour, so that you may live with grace and with
honour, without sin, without shame and without evil,
with joy of your body and of your soul and of your worldly
honour. Amen.
